supplementalTo.meaning: This file remains byte-for-byte frozen; this additive closure supersedes its pending-scope dispositions only where stated.

granularityDefinition: Close each original unit by a specific product-scope classification and bounded source content type. For generic tables/procedures in scope, inventory table identity, headings/axes, physical row-label denominator, marker/qualifier/notes and continuation segments before comparing the whole bounded family to captured current owners. For wholly absent tables, do not transcribe every monster-name/value cell merely to classify the finite table family absent. For the documented excluded bestiary, keep profile fields/prose/abilities unassessed and explicitly excluded. A closed unit classification is not a whole-book content-completeness claim.

reviewMethod.pixelInspection: Original source PDF was opened and rendered with PyMuPDF at 216 dpi for the in-scope pp.5–7, p.131, pp.133–155, frontmatter/covers and index pages; images were inspected one page per result. Printed p.135/PDF p.136 heading `GOLD CIVILIZED REGIONS` was separately cropped from the original PDF at 432 dpi (PDF-point crop x=102,y=370,w=148,h=55) and inspected. All full-page renders and crops remain in private scratch. OCR/lexical candidates were not treated as proof.
reviewMethod.siteJoin: Fresh gzip.open of the frozen snapshot: bind both compressed-file and decompressed-JSON identities. SourceRecord, captured visible detail text/content, publicSearch document and title self-query evidence are read from actual records. The snapshot confirms every owner route/detail and every title-search self-match, but does not prove a precise citation highlight.
reviewMethod.sourcePageMapping: Printed/page locators use the frozen sourcePageBackreferences; preserve the known non-linear mapping anomaly printed p.83 -> PDF p.92. For frontmatter, p.1–3 locators are sequential catalog locations but no visible folio; printed p.4 is visible on the preface page.
reviewMethod.limitations: The task does not assert all MM2 profile headings or all numeric profile fields have been enumerated. The app README documents exclusion of a searchable bestiary. Generic source definitions, spell-support facts and encounter/reference procedures remain assessed separately.
reviewMethod.originalUnitIdentity: Exactly one unitReviews record per one of the 41 original IDs. The two monster scope records retain separate bounded profile-population notes alongside their live Zombie-fact assertions.
reviewMethod.assertionIdentity: Subassertion IDs are unique within the artifact. The live Zombie subset is assessed once under monster-entries-az and cross-referenced from monster-statblocks-and-prose.
